study.question: Can the unchanged full112 factored training model preserve validation click AUC and its auxiliary predictions while reducing measured prediction cost by folding its buy-context product and then fusing its semantic branch affines? Does its advantage over dense training survive a common inference topology?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: full112 achieves click AUC0.6674485580556159 with205427 dense Parameters, versus separate dense0.6672902815744913/192883. Rank56 and70 give0.6670415671291718 and0.6668936333381517; rank35 energy restoration0.66682759997943 and output-heavy balancing0.6669938630290305 did not rescue the full112 quality. Repeated historical full112 AUC values use the same seed, so they establish deterministic bridges, not independent mechanism support. The full112 context factor contains no intervening activation: its learned effective map can be evaluated as W=output@input without reducing its training rank. Hypothesis: useful optimization capacity may be retained during training while redundant per-example inference work is removed. Fusion can further reduce dispatch and intermediate additions. This is an inference information-flow intervention and ordinary linear algebra, with no new architecture/priority claim or reduction of trained Parameters. The effect may be below whole-model timing noise.

nearest_work.difference: Inherited successful standalone full112 module and exact native training path. Add only evaluation implementations of its buy first affine; no rank truncation or training-loss change.

Inherited dense replacement provides lower-parameter training comparison. Its fused inference topology matches the factor-trained fused candidate after per-call product formation; parameters and optimizer geometry differ during training.

Pinned primary benchmark source lines203-211 implements the standard consecutive down/up linear factor without intermediate activation. We fold an inherited buy-context map at evaluation, preserve all training parameters, and fuse existing semantic branch affines. No HiFormer token/attention architecture is adopted; benchmark code is not the original-paper implementation audit.

Original-paper metadata resolved; detailed text unavailable through the authorized source, with explicit benchmark fallback read. Ordinary factorization is prior machinery. Originality/whole-method reproduction remain unverified; no priority claim.

study.proposed_difference: Add owner_context_evaluation=native|folded|fused. Native and every training call execute the original factor/local operations unchanged. Folded evaluates the current FP32 product of context_output[112,112] and context_input[112,192] using one context affine, retaining the two local affines. Fused concatenates each half of that product with the corresponding local weights and each context input with its gathered local input, then executes two affine calls. Form products in FP32 with autocast disabled only for the small derived weight product; all batch affines retain host BF16 autocast. No caches, new learned tensors, persistent derived buffers, checkpoint access, intermediate activations or parameter deletion. Dense_fused uses the existing separate context_weight with the same fusion. Four standalone modules differ only in literal CONFIG.
predictions: Full112 native/product/fused have identical training state and updates under deterministic host execution,205427 dense plus31793216 embedding Parameters (31998643 total). Dense_fused has192883 dense (31986099 total),12544 fewer trained Parameters; it is not an optimization-matched control.

At a fixed state folding is equal over real arithmetic. BF16 rounding can change buy predictions; click/cart/fav should be exactly unchanged because only the buy evaluation affine changes. Full112 modes should meet the prospective per-task quality gates below.

Buy first-affine per-example MACs, excluding bias/activation/gather: native45696, folded33152, fused33152. Folded/fused additionally form112*112*192=2408448 FP32 MACs per call. At B8192 the analytic batch MAC reduction is102760448-2408448=100352000 for this affine. This is not a whole-model speedup estimate. Fusion removes one batch GEMM and post-concatenation addition relative to folded, but adds input/weight concatenations.

Prospective screen before any new scoring: click AUC >= fresh native AUC-0.0002 AND >=0.666553547526167 (entry0.666753547526167 minus0.0002). Full112 inference variants additionally require every auxiliary AUC >=native-0.0002 and each task Logloss <=native+0.0001. Exact unchanged click/cart/fav predictions are a source-isolation prerequisite at the same trained state. Dense_fused auxiliary losses remain fully reported and cannot be hidden behind click selection.

Efficiency screen: at least1% lower model-only p50 batch latency than contemporaneous native, p95<=1.01*native, end-to-end validation inference seconds<=1.02*native, with the same8192/partial-batch schedule, hardware, precision and loading. Require paired repeats before an efficiency claim; a single-pass timing win is provisional. Training wall time and peak memory are reported with a5% training-time warning threshold, not presumed improved.

Select among qualifying full112 candidates by lower contemporaneous p50, then lower p95, then higher click AUC. Dense_fused is a replacement control, never automatically promoted by its role. Report all four task outcomes, auxiliary mean, all inherited history-length slices with sample/positive/negative counts and differences from baseline/entry, including substantial inherited auxiliary degradation. No new slice mechanism is claimed.
falsifiers: Any difference in initialized or one-step trained state among the three full112 modes refutes training isolation and blocks the experiment until corrected; failed checks/costs remain recorded.

FP32 failure against the explicit effective matrix, changed click/cart/fav predictions at a fixed state, or mutated evaluation buffers refutes correctness/isolation. BF16 buy deviation that breaches quality gates rejects that implementation.

No repeatable measured prediction-cost reduction meeting the frozen gate rejects utility even if MAC counts decrease and AUC is preserved. Added FP32 product/input concatenations may dominate the saved batch compute.

If fused factor training and fused dense training have indistinguishable repeated quality/cost, the alleged benefit of maintaining the extra training factor capacity is unsupported; one same-seed AUC gap is insufficient.

Failure of both folding candidates limits this bounded implementation, not all deployment folding or all capacity reallocation. Success would support this arithmetic/cost transformation, not a new sequence mechanism or general multi-task superiority.
alternative_explanations: BF16 intermediate rounding, GEMM shape/kernel selection, FP32 product cost and memory traffic rather than capacity or information explain differences.
Data loading, allocator warmup, GPU clock/load and run order can swamp a subpercent whole-model gain. Model-only p50/p95 and end-to-end time answer different cost questions.

Full112 versus dense training changes parameterization, AdamW states, weight decay and global dense clipping despite equal initial effective matrix; exact initialization does not make optimizer trajectories equivalent.
